title: Fix hardcoded Date header in Email/set create (bt5.22 regression)
description: mail/email/set.rs create_one_email still uses hardcoded 'Mon, 01 Jan 2024 00:00:00 +0000'. The bt5.22 fix was not applied. Fix: use epoch_to_rfc2822((timestamp / 1000) as i64) — timestamp variable is already computed on line 183.
